name: Stability Ball Prone Hip Rotation
steps: Lie face down with your hips supported on the ball, legs extended and both palms planted on the floor.
Keep one foot grounded and open the other leg to the side, turning gently at the hip.
Bring that leg back behind you and lower the foot with control.
Continue alternating legs through a comfortable range.
tips: Keep your shoulders level over your hands as each hip opens.
Keep the movement small enough that your lower back stays steady.
